DESCRIPTION: When buildup reaches #b100%, the target loses #b15% of max HP; after triggering, subtract #b100% and keep overflow.
When buildup reaches #b100%, you lose #b33% of max HP, then the buildup resets to #b0. Madness does not disappear after combat.
At end of turn, lose #b5% of max HP and reduce this by #b1 stack.
At #b10 stacks, consume all Dragon Faith and become Dragonkin. While Dragonkin, Dragon Faith gained is converted into Energy.
Damage you deal is doubled. Dragon Faith gained afterward is converted into Energy. Block is not doubled.
